Results.ReviewText:
I always thought I couldn't 'afford' to buy a Weber Gas grill, and instead wasted money on cheaper grills that did not last more than three years.  I was gifted a new Spirit II E-310 grill for Christmas, and can already see the quality in this grill.  I should have made this jump years ago.  
The build quality is outstanding, and the warranty blows all the others away.
The precise flame control is outstanding.  The grill heats quickly, but evenly.
The Fuel Gauge enables you to quickly see the amount of LP left, without having to remove the tank to 'weigh' it.
Be aware that only the left side table folds down (the right side is above where the fuel tank is at, so is blocked from folding).

I should have made the switch to the Weber Spirit II E-310 years ago!
Results.Title: Great investment!

Results.ReviewText:
Purchased first E310 from Lowe's Home Center Kyle Texas on 11-18-21 while still in crate.
When delivered assembled in December, the igniter would not function and could not be removed for inspection as outlined in manual. I had this unit picked up and returned to Lowe's.
After conversations with Lowe's return desk, I was able to receive delivery of a replacement E310 unit yesterday December 23. Originally was advised that replacement could not be assembled and delivered until December 31. The spark igniter seems to work on the replacement unit but one of the side trays is slightly damaged and the lid surface in one place has a spot of discoloration on the black painted surface.
Results.Title: E310 Problems
